pre-commit.command: python -c "import sys; [sys.exit(1) for line in open(sys.argv[1]) if any(w in line.lower() for w in ['approximately','estimated at','roughly','around','about']) and '[ESTIMATE]' not in line and 'sources.csv' not in sys.argv[1] and line.strip().startswith(('$','₹','₩','KRW','INR','USD','Rs','US$'))]" %f
pre-commit.description: Block unsourced quantitative claims — any line starting with a currency marker that contains hedging language without an [ESTIMATE] tag is rejected
